summary: Final cycle. key_insight: The complete answer: measure the 6 WHO classical pollutants (+indoor CO2/radon/VOC, +pollen feed for allergics); output personal INHALED DOSE (not just ambient AQI) across a 6-layer taxonomy; and deploy the AI as an anticipatory, transparent, non-diagnostic advisor that warns before symptoms (exploiting the lag structure), weights pollutants by condition, escalates at AQI 100+ for respiratory users, and learns personal thresholds — gated by mandatory RH-aware sensor calibration and general-wellness (non-diagnostic) framing.
